name: docketx-open-law
description: Open, public-domain U.S. law as data: all 51 jurisdictions' case law, 27 states' statutes and 21,000 court rules held word for word on Hugging Face under docketx/, plus a verification layer over them (does this citation exist, does it support this proposition, what does the rule actually say). Points you at CourtListener for case-law search and at DocketX for the rest.
